Nadia: Hypothetical: our main model wants to take vacation days. What does its OOO message look like? :beach_with_umbrella:
Rafi: 'Out generating memories. Replies may be slightly hallucinatory until return.' :sunglasses:
Lin: 'On PTO. Please route urgent prompts to my smaller, less confident sibling model.'
Taylor: @Lin savage. :joy: Also: it would send back-of-the-napkin haikus to auto-replies.
OpsBot: Reminder: models cannot accrue PTO. HR flagged this as a Tier-2 meme. :robot_face:
Nadia: Vote for OOO tone: 1) Professional 2) Dramatic 3) Passive-aggressive 4) Existential
Rafi: 4 for sure. It would send 'I have seen the tokens in the void' as an away message. :dizzy:
Lin: 2. Make it performative. Add a vacation-themed system prompt: ```You are on a beach. Only respond with five-word vacation captions.```
Taylor: We should actually make an email OOO generator called "Model in Margaritaville". Fund me. :money_mouth_face:
Nadia: Sticker idea: tiny beach chair + tiny GPU. Very on-brand. :beach_umbrella:
Rafi: Bonus: insincere manager comment when it returns: 'Welcome back, we've missed your creative edits to the handbook.' :clap:
OpsBot: System note logged: vacation-memes trending. Reaction count: 12 :thumbsup:
